name: elmdb-workspace
description: The tooling that builds and tests elmdb's binding (crates/elmdb-node), kept out of the package it publishes so that a project linking the binding installs none of it

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 crates/elmdb-node/protocol/*.ts crates/elmdb-node/index.d.ts && tsc --noEmit --strict --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --allowJs --checkJs crates/elmdb-node/test/schema-types.test.mjs
